caption: Begijnhof, Breda
composition: Long court of low brick houses and a small neoclassical chapel · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Begijnhof at Breda is a long court of low brick houses, mostly from the 17th century and raised by a storey early in the 18th. The beguine chapel of 1836-1838 is a single-aisle neoclassical front on the court. It is overcast, about 15.3°C, with wind near 11.2 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. No sign is readable. The castle, the Grote Kerk, and the Spanjaardsgat are other scenes and are not in this frame.
